blurb: Guests can participate in adult recreational hockey leagues governed by USA Hockey rules, join beginner hockey clinics, attend skate and shoot practice sessions, or book skating parties with food and party room access. The adult hockey league requires players to be at least 18 years old and registered with USA Hockey.
extraNote: No refunds for beginner clinics but credits offered if notified 10 days before start · Teams must pay for referees and scorekeeper if last-minute game change not communicated · Forfeiture fee assessed for teams failing to arrive for scheduled games · No outside food or drinks allowed at skating parties except cake
